longitude, timestamps, and transportation modes.

metrics.name: inference time-cost

Beyond the accuracy performance, we also compared the inference efficiency (time cost) between
the proposed method and diffusion-based version (TrajFlow-w/o-FM). As Figure. 10 and Table. 4
shows, the flow matching-based approach has a much higher efficiency than the diffusion-based
approach. Specifically, the diffusion-based version requires over 30× more inference time-cost while
achieving accuracy levels that are comparable yet still lower than TrajFlow.
